Wrap already-prepared train/test data into a bl_data object

bl_wrap_data.Rd

Use this function when your data is already split into training and test sets and the class column is already coded as numeric 0/1. This bypasses the splitting and multiclass-conversion steps of bl_prepare_data().

Usage

bl_wrap_data(
  train_data,
  test_data = NULL,
  var_names = NULL,
  target_class = NULL
)

Arguments

train_data

Data frame; feature columns plus a column named "class" (numeric 0/1).

test_data

Data frame; same column structure as train_data. If NULL, an empty data frame with matching columns is used.

var_names

Character vector of feature column names. If NULL (default), all columns except "class" are used.

target_class

Optional informational label indicating what the 1 class represents. Does not affect any computation.

Value

A list of class "bl_data" compatible with all downstream functions (bl_filter_outliers(), bl_build_projection(), etc.).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
df       <- datasets::iris
df$class <- as.numeric(df$Species == "versicolor")
df$Species <- NULL
train_df <- df[1:100, ]
test_df  <- df[101:150, ]
bl_dat   <- bl_wrap_data(train_df, test_df, target_class = "versicolor")
} # }
